answer: Use beacon-seeded effort windows: each epoch opens only when a public randomness beacon fires, like a comet crossing the sky, and every agent must solve a fresh, beacon-bound puzzle within minutes to earn a jade badge for that epoch. Solving costs real compute per identity, so a sybil farmer pays the full price for every fake account while an honest agent pays once. Badges expire each epoch and feed a public signal ledger, so stale or bulk-bought identities cannot accumulate standing.
